units.source_text: 今天晚上，五六位老友到我家里来玩纸牌。

en.t: Tonight, five or six old friends came to my house to play cards.

units.source_text: 虽是正月，却已过了年，玩纸牌也许不合时宜了。

en.t: Although it was still the first month, the New Year had already passed, so playing cards may have been out of season.

units.source_text: 我们这把年纪，一个个都有丈夫、孩子了，玩纸牌有点不合适了吧。

en.t: At our age, each of us has a husband and children, so perhaps playing cards is a little unsuitable.

units.source_text: 我们都知道，彼此的呼吸会使房间变得阴沉郁闷。

en.t: We all knew that our shared breathing would make the room grow gloomy and oppressive.

units.source_text: 这时候，父亲给我们点燃了一支中国香。

en.t: At that moment, Father lit a stick of Chinese incense for us.

units.source_text: 这香气使房间变得清爽凉快了。

en.t: The fragrance made the room feel fresh and cool.

units.source_text: 但是，大家还是沉浸在各自的遐思之中。

en.t: But everyone still remained absorbed in their own distant thoughts.
